_doc: Full-story easter eggs. Read only by systems/EasterEggRoute.gd. The eight authored eggs lived in the old random pool, which the full story never runs (0 exposures in 28 full-run traces, 2026-11-26). On a free full-story week the first egg in this order whose own conditions hold (EventManager.deferred_event_is_eligible) and that has not played yet appears, at most one per min_gap_weeks. Each egg's own conditions and once-only flag stay the source of truth. rest_weeks stay quiet.
